name: Fishing Log
summary: Keep count of your fishing catches in every zone and see how many you pull in per hour.
logoPrompt: A small open fisherman's logbook with a feather quill resting on its pages, a red and white fishing bobber and a silver fish lying beside it on weathered wooden planks

cover.tagline: Every cast counted, every zone noted.

description: **Fishing Log writes down every catch you make, so you know where you fished most and how fast the fish are biting right now.**
- Counts every catch and the items it brought, the moment the fishing loot window opens.
- Catches per zone for the current session and for all time.
- Catches per hour for the session, so you can compare spots.
- All-time totals are shared by every character of your account.

Just fish. Type `/fl` (or `/fishinglog`) to see the session in chat: catches, items, catches per hour and your top zones. `/fl zones` lists all your catches per zone, `/fl reset` starts a new session.
- Works on Retail. It counts loot windows that the game marks as fishing loot and reads no combat data and no chat.
- The rate appears after two catches and five minutes of fishing. A new session starts at login, after a reload or with `/fl reset`.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
